appStore.subtitle: Track spending, split bills
appStore.promotionalText: Track spending and income, set budgets, plan your recurring payments and split bills with friends. Free, with no ads, in English and Greek.
appStore.description:
Budgeer keeps track of your money and splits shared costs with friends, in one app.

YOUR MONEY
• Log expenses and income in any currency. Foreign amounts convert at the European Central Bank rate of the day and keep that rate.
• Set a monthly budget per category, with a heads-up at 80% and when you go over.
• Keep your recurring payments and income in one place. Plan lets you try changes to them (cancel a subscription, add a new bill) and see what's left each month before you change anything.
• Savings: your savings pot, goals and net worth.
• Meal vouchers: the card's balance and next top-up, worked out from your working days.
• Your salary: pay history, raises, extras, and how your pay compares with prices.
• Import bank statements (CSV or Excel), read on your iPhone. Scan a receipt with the camera; the photo stays on your iPhone.

WITH FRIENDS
• Make a group for a trip, your flat or a night out, and invite friends with a link.
• Split equally, by amount, percentage or shares, in any currency.
• Budgeer works out the fewest payments to settle up and shows each friend's IBAN, Revolut or PayPal.

YOUR DATA
• Amounts and notes are stored encrypted, in a database in the EU (Paris).
• No ads, no analytics, and your data is never sold.
• An optional Face ID lock, and encrypted backups you can download.
• The AI helpers (type an entry in your own words, category ideas on import, your month in plain words, what-ifs in Plan) are optional and off until you turn them on.

In English and Greek. Your account works on the website too, at budgeer.com.

Budgeer is a free project run by one person. It never holds or moves money, and it doesn't give financial advice.

testFlight.whatToTest:
Thanks for testing Budgeer. Please try:
• Sign up or sign in (email, Apple or Google).
• Add an expense and an income, in your currency and in another one.
• Set a budget, add a recurring payment and open Plan.
• Make a group, invite a friend with the link and split an expense.
• Import a bank statement (CSV or Excel) or scan a receipt.
• Turn on the Face ID lock and notifications in Settings.

Send feedback with a screenshot from TestFlight, or email support@budgeer.com.

appStore.subtitle: Test version, test data
appStore.promotionalText: The test version of Budgeer, for trying new features before they reach the app. It uses the test server at dev.budgeer.com and test data.
appStore.description:
Budgeer Dev is the test version of Budgeer, for trying new features before they reach the Budgeer app.

It connects to the test server at dev.budgeer.com and uses test data: its accounts are separate from budgeer.com, and anything entered here may be changed or removed. Please don't keep real records in it; use Budgeer for that.

What it does is the same as Budgeer:
• Expenses and income in any currency, at the European Central Bank rate of the day.
• Monthly budgets per category, recurring payments, and Plan to try changes to them.
• Savings, meal vouchers and salary insights.
• Bank statement import (CSV or Excel) and receipt scanning on your iPhone.
• Groups with friends: split costs and settle up by IBAN, Revolut or PayPal.
• Amounts and notes stored encrypted; no ads, no analytics, data never sold.
• Optional AI helpers, off until you turn them on.

In English and Greek.
